note: Hand-labelled ground truth for the uncertainty lint. The 24 'corpus' lines are VERBATIM from real landed artifacts under revenue/uiowa_rfq_18649_* and were read individually before labelling. The 10 'constructed' lines are authored, and are labelled as such, because the real corpus contains only one true positive -- which makes recall unmeasurable from the corpus alone. Precision and recall are reported separately for the two origins in the README so the constructed cases cannot flatter the corpus result.
